infractions.rule: a (code, text) pair is allowlisted when both are present, the code has exactly one text across all ten columns citywide, and the text has no unit, floor, email, phone or honorific pattern

hearing_status_definition: The ECB dictionary defines hearing_status only as "Status of the hearing" and gives no value list. The grouping is the project's, not DOB's or OATH's, and has not been checked against OATH records (validation part D is pending).

ADMIT/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as ADMIT/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the ADMIT prefix.

CURED/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as CURED/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the CURED prefix.

DEFAULT.note: Recorded as DEFAULT. The meaning of DEFAULT is not documented in the ECB or OATH dataset dictionaries. It is grouped as upheld_by_default, kept apart from upheld, and is not presented as a decision on the merits.

POP/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as POP/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the meaning of POP is not documented.

STIPULATION/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as STIPULATION/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the STIPULATION prefix.

WRITTEN OFF.note: Recorded as WRITTEN OFF. The meaning is not documented. It is not read as upheld or dismissed.

correction_status.definition: "whether or not the violation has been corrected. This is the status of the violation with DOB, not the status of the hearing with OATH. ACTIVE - still needs to be addressed; RESOLVE - the issue was either fixed with DOB or dismissed by OATH"

severity_note: The ECB dictionary lists Hazardous, Non-Hazardous and Unknown. CLASS - 1, 2 and 3 are in use but not documented there; they are shown as recorded and flagged.
